target.name: Plantd Materials
target.founder: Nathan Silvernail, Huade Tan, Josh Dorfman

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $42M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Plantd Materials is a Series B materials-science company founded by Nathan Silvernail, Huade Tan, and Josh Dorfman. The company has raised $42M to date. The analysis relies on a single applicable valuation method due to limited comparable company data availability; no public or private peers were identified for direct benchmarking.

Stage-progression analysis, the primary method applied, uses the $42M total capital raised as a proxy for current implied valuation and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-subsequent-stage progression. This method yields an implied valuation of $80M. The low and high bounds of the range—$68M and $92M respectively—reflect reasonable variance around the median implied value, corresponding to step-up multipliers of approximately 1.6x and 2.2x.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $68M to $92M, with a median point of $80M. The key limitation is reliance on a single methodology in the absence of transaction comparables or public market data. Any revision to this range would require either identification of relevant private company precedent transactions in advanced materials or clarification of capital efficiency and burn metrics relative to comparable Series B frontier-tech investments. Until such data emerges, uncertainty around the upper and lower bounds remains material.
